title: Borrow operation and running-time bound
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose find mode, and let $x$ be an input word. For any host configuration used as a base, input-head position, and Boolean word $w$, the borrow position $b(w)$ satisfies $2b(w)+2\le 2|w|+2$. Starting from the specified host frame in control phase 8, with the counter tape storing $w$ and the other designated tapes blank, after $2b(w)+2$ steps the frame is in the return call state with the anchor and release flag true if the debit operation on $w$ reports a carry; otherwise it is in control phase 11. The counter tape then stores the debited word, and the designated head positions and output are reset as specified by the frame.
